rejected.reason: Parenthetical tracking identifiers and alternate designations are alias annotations; aliases, renames, and spelling variants are not rungs.
Dropping the numeric identifier destroys the identity-bearing designation of the tracking cluster.
Sponsoring military or government intelligence agencies belong to an organization/government category, violating the same-category gate.

ladder.notes: The observed surface forms represent individual threat actors, tracking clusters (e.g., CERT-UA UAC designations), and composite alias mentions. No valid intra-category hierarchical containment, sub-units, or broad kinds are attested in the evidence.
